boundaries: Observed native identifier-classifier events only; not exhaustive dependency or runtime tracing.
Reference identity is scoped to the captured context; event multiplicity and ancestry tags are not unique successful checks or roots.
Constants and fvars remain distinct; module hints name the first imported owner, not the selected proof-body origin.
Native coalescing is diagnostic only, using original references plus actual alias leaves; never used as graph edges.
Generated-origin events and typed name keys are retained separately; no lexical inference supplies use edges.
